items.title: Additivity of the cap with a first Chern class in the tensor product of two invertible sheaves, and vanishing for the trivial sheaf
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma records the two structural properties of the cap with a first Chern class: additivity in the tensor product of two invertible sheaves and vanishing for the trivial sheaf (statement lines 4329-4341). The additivity is read off from the known additivity of the divisor construction, while the vanishing is proved by exhibiting the constant section, which is everywhere nonzero on each integral closed subscheme. The argument on the constant section is the substance, so the claim is H2.
